title: Étale closed/open interchange and closure-defined extension by zero
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $X$ a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). Use ordinary module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on small étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and open extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. For a cartesian square with $g:Z\hookrightarrow X$ closed [def-weil-closed-immersion], $u:W\hookrightarrow X$ open [def-weil-open-immersion], $Z_W=Z\times_XW$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and projections $v:Z_W\hookrightarrow Z$ open and $h:Z_W\hookrightarrow W$ closed, for every $A_{Z_W}$-module sheaf $L$ there is a natural isomorphism
$$u_!h_*L\xrightarrow{\sim}g_*v_!L.$$
Its specified map is the transpose under $u_!\dashv u^*$ of the inverse of $u^*g_*v_!L\cong h_*v^*v_!L\cong h_*L$.
For any locally closed immersion $a:S\hookrightarrow X$, let $C$ be its scheme-theoretic closure [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-image], $j:S\hookrightarrow C$ the open immersion and $c:C\hookrightarrow X$ the closed immersion, and define $a_!=c_*j_!$. For every factorization $a=u\circ h$ with $h:S\hookrightarrow W$ closed and $u:W\hookrightarrow X$ open [def-weil-open-immersion], there is a canonical natural identification $a_!\cong u_!h_*$ restricting to the identity on $S$. If also $i:Y\hookrightarrow X$ is closed and $b:S\hookrightarrow Y$ is locally closed with $a=i\circ b$, there is a natural identification $i_*b_!\cong a_!$, where $b_!$ is likewise defined through its scheme-theoretic closure in $Y$.

source.place: Tag 0GJ1 (lemma-compatible-shriek-push-finite), closed-immersion case. Closure-factorization identification and compatibility with a further closed immersion are extracted consequences, with scheme-theoretic closure as in the parent conventions.

proof.text: Closed immersions are finite [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite]. Apply Etale.isIso_finiteOpenComparison [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-extension-zero] with ModuleCat A and the canonical pullback square. This proves the first conjunct with exactly the specified comparison [def-weil-pbc-finite-open-comparison]. The existing theorem is generic in the coefficient category and applies directly to module sheaves, so no separate scalar-linearity argument is necessary.

The embedding of an immersion a:S→X induces a Noetherian topology on S from the Noetherian X [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian]. Every subset of S is compact, hence every scheme map out of S is quasi-compact. This also proves quasi-compactness for b:S→Y without needing to establish that Y is Noetherian. The open image factors and their scheme-theoretic density are supplied by [lemma-nagata-immersion-open-in-scheme-image].

For a=h≫j with h closed and j open, the square (id_S,h,a,j) is cartesian because j is a monomorphism. The arbitrary-pullback kernel API Scheme.Hom.ker_of_isPullback in [lemma-nagata-scheme-image-restrict-open] gives h.ker=a.ker.comap j. Since a.imageι.ker=a.ker, the closed-immersion pullback criterion gives the cartesian closure square (a.toImage,h,a.imageι,j). Invert the finite/open comparison of step 1 to get an initial natural isomorphism from the closure extension to h_* followed by j_!.

source.place: Tags 01R6--01R8; kernel form of restriction of the image

proof.text: Normalize the initial comparison purely categorically. Write F for the closure extension, G for h_* followed by j_!, R=a^*, and α:FR≅Id, β:GR≅Id for the existing displayed restriction helpers. These helpers use the open unit [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-unit-iso], closed counit [prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful], and inverse-image composition [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Given e₀:F≅G, set γ=(e₀▷R)β and τ=γ⁻¹α:Id≅Id. Let θ:F≅F have components F(τ_s). Naturality of γ gives R(θ_s)γ_s=γ_sτ_s=α_s, so e=θe₀ has the required normalization. For uniqueness, if e and e′ have the same restriction, f=e′_s e_s⁻¹ has R(f)=id. The functor F is fully faithful: the open unit and its adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction] make open extension fully faithful, and closed pushforward is fully faithful by the cited closed-counit result. Lift f to F.preimage(f). Naturality of α shows this preimage is id, whence f=id and e′=e. These are proved private categorical lemmas, with no new assumptions or holes.

source.place: Tags 0F70 and 04CA; elementary normalization by naturality and full faithfulness

proof.text: For a=b≫i with i closed, let D=b.image and C=a.image. The density of b.toImage from [lemma-nagata-immersion-open-in-scheme-image] implies ker(b.toImage≫(b.imageι≫i))=ker(b.imageι≫i). Thus a.imageι.ker=(b.imageι≫i).ker. The closed lift [lemma-nagata-scheme-image-universal] from D to C for this ideal equality is an isomorphism by the closed-immersion equal-kernel criterion. Its composite with a.imageι is b.imageι≫i. Cancel the monomorphism a.imageι to obtain b.toImage≫q=a.toImage.

source.place: Tags 01R6--01R8; ideal-sheaf form of the minimal closed factorization

proof.text: Associativity of direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] identifies b_! followed by i_* with b.toImage_! followed by q_* and a.imageι_*. For the isomorphism q, direct image q_* is inverse pullback and hence equals open extension q_!, by uniqueness of left adjoints using [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. Apply composition of open extensions [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition] and b.toImage≫q=a.toImage to get the initial closed-composition comparison. Normalize it by step 4 with F=b_! followed by i_*, G=a_!, and the existing helper etaleClosedCompositionRestrictionIso for α. Full faithfulness of this F follows by composition, giving the specified uniqueness too.

source.place: Direct-image formula and extension-by-zero adjunction; Tags 0F70 and 04CA

proof_origin.place: Tag 0GJ1 with morphisms.tex Tags 01R6--01R8; C1 Lean proof uses kernel base change for the closure square, equal kernels for closed composition, and explicit categorical normalization by naturality. Both closure comparisons and uniqueness are completely proved.

lean.statement: theorem etale_locallyClosed_extension_comparison {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [Finite A] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion g] (u : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion u] : IsIso (Etale.finiteOpenComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g u)) ∧ ∀ {S : Scheme.{u}} (a : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion a], ∃ hqa : QuasiCompact a, (∀ {W' : Scheme.{u}} (h : S ⟶ W') (u' : W' ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion h] [IsOpenImmersion u'], (ha : h ≫ u' = a) → ∃ e : etaleLocallyClosedExtension (A := A) a hqa ≅ Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h ⋙ Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u', Functor.isoWhiskerRight e (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) a) ≪≫ etaleFactorizationRestrictionIso (A := A) a h u' ha = etaleLocallyClosedExtensionRestrictionIso (A := A) a hqa ∧ ∀ e' : etaleLocallyClosedExtension (A := A) a hqa ≅ Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h ⋙ Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u', Functor.isoWhiskerRight e' (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) a) ≪≫ etaleFactorizationRestrictionIso (A := A) a h u' ha = etaleLocallyClosedExtensionRestrictionIso (A := A) a hqa → e' = e) ∧ (∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (b : S ⟶ Y) [IsImmersion b], (ha : b ≫ i = a) → ∃ hqb : QuasiCompact b, ∃ e : etaleLocallyClosedExtension (A := A) b hqb ⋙ Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i ≅ etaleLocallyClosedExtension (A := A) a hqa, Functor.isoWhiskerRight e (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) a) ≪≫ etaleLocallyClosedExtensionRestrictionIso (A := A) a hqa = etaleClosedCompositionRestrictionIso (A := A) a b i hqb ha ∧ ∀ e' : etaleLocallyClosedExtension (A := A) b hqb ⋙ Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i ≅ etaleLocallyClosedExtension (A := A) a hqa, Functor.isoWhiskerRight e' (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) a) ≪≫ etaleLocallyClosedExtensionRestrictionIso (A := A) a hqa = etaleClosedCompositionRestrictionIso (A := A) a b i hqb ha → e' = e)
